procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review, without spawning, forking or resuming, and without reading peer reviews or unlisted embedded records. Verified all 33 explicit pins by exact SHA-256 and byte count. Read packet, case, rubric, review rules, compact addendum, recording README, adapter and the five pinned image manifests; did not follow their unlisted embedded paths. The packet supplies zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so actual source-image opens and protected-layout reads are both zero and the respective arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected all 15 exact poster views with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), emitted as unchanged images: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, and M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. Completed this entire sequence before the first text-reading/transcription stage, any image judgment, or any score. Then read the visible copy from these displayed views in the twelve-entry packet order and retained first readings. One subsequent exact-native open of M1 inspected both ambiguous range separators and left both unresolved; one subsequent exact-native open of M2 inspected both range separators and resolved both as short hyphens. Actual poster opens total 17: fifteen initial ordered opens plus these two stated native revisits. No other image opens, crops, substituted views, image generation or image editing. Each copy entry has at most one revisit; first raw readings remain unchanged. Native/use/thumbnail PNG headers were read and match packet dimensions at 1672×941, 720×405, 320×180; color type 2 confirms opaque RGB. Ratio PASS uses |941−1672×9/16|=0.5 pixel under the pinned nearest-integer-single-edge policy, not a claim of mathematically exact native 16:9. Viewing receipts are my semantic attestations to the actual displayed assets, not invented tool-event or session IDs.
